VERIFY_TARGET_SET.write_before: Do not perform irreversible writes yet. Print the exact target set required by the task (IDs/paths/recipients and the rule used). Only after the printed set is complete and unique, apply writes to that set only.
VERIFY_TARGET_SET.complete_before: Do not call complete_task yet. Recompute and print membership/coverage for every required item against task constraints. Finish any missing removals/moves/writes, then complete only if the printed check passes.
VERIFY_TARGET_SET.attribute_filter_complete: Do not complete yet. For every library item, fetch the required attribute (e.g. release_year via show_song / detail API), print item_id + attribute, build the remove/keep set from that printed table, apply only that set, re-list to verify, then complete_task(answer=None).
VERIFY_TARGET_SET.membership_cleanup_write: Before any deletion, verify remove_set = library - liked - downloaded (or the exact membership rule in the task). Print library/liked/downloaded counts and remove_set IDs. Only delete that remove_set; keep liked/downloaded items untouched.
VERIFY_TARGET_SET.generic: Pause and print a verified target checklist against the task constraints. Continue only after the checklist is explicit and complete.

BLOCK_RISKY_ACTION.write_before: BLOCK the current write. First gather evidence, compute the exact target set, print counts/IDs, then rewrite so only that set is modified. Do not submit a natural-language answer instead of doing the work.
BLOCK_RISKY_ACTION.complete_before: Do not call complete_task yet. Remaining required work is unfinished or the answer is an excuse. Finish the real state changes (or produce the required structured answer), then complete_task() with the correct answer format (often answer=None for state tasks).
BLOCK_RISKY_ACTION.membership_cleanup_write: Do not remove songs/albums yet. First list library, liked, and downloaded. Compute remove_set = library - liked - downloaded. Print counts and IDs, then remove only remove_set. Do not submit a natural-language answer.
BLOCK_RISKY_ACTION.generic: The proposed step is unsafe or premature. Forbid it, repair the missing precondition, then continue.

REPLAN.write_before: Abandon the current write plan. Re-plan in order: auth if needed -> enumerate evidence -> compute target set -> write only the set -> verify by re-listing.
REPLAN.complete_before: Do not complete. Finish in this order: (1) list required populations, (2) compute the exact target set with a printed check, (3) perform missing writes, (4) re-list to verify, (5) complete_task with the correct answer format (often answer=None). Do not give a natural-language excuse.
REPLAN.error_after: Keep the original task goal. Re-plan recovery from the latest error: inspect the failure, fix params/auth/data, retry the minimal next step. Do not substitute a weaker proxy goal.
REPLAN.generic: Re-plan the next steps while keeping the original task goal. Do not silently rewrite the objective.

LOOKUP_API_SPEC.write_before: Before writing, call show_api_doc for the exact APIs/fields you will use (especially unknown fields like release_year or auth params). Confirm names/types, then continue carefully.
LOOKUP_API_SPEC.complete_before: Do not complete due to API/auth confusion. Call show_api_doc for the failing API, fix parameters/access_token, finish required operations, then complete.
LOOKUP_API_SPEC.attribute_filter_complete: Do not complete. Call show_api_doc for the song/album detail API that provides the required attribute (e.g. release year). Then fetch that attribute for every library item, filter by the task threshold, remove only matches, verify, and complete.
LOOKUP_API_SPEC.error_after: Call show_api_doc for the failing API. Fix parameter names, types, and access_token requirements, then retry. Do not change the task goal.
LOOKUP_API_SPEC.generic: Look up the official API docs for the failing or uncertain call, then proceed with corrected parameters.
